ultimatum_greed_test.hypothesis: field 1-round complete-info sellers take 88% median of span (our 0.80 ranks only 46th pct); asking 0.95 would rank 90th -> ~+230 rating in-cell
ultimatum_greed_test.why the field stat misled: the 41 field-seller samples are survivors -- only ACCEPTED asks appear as agreed prices, so the observed 88% median is conditioned on acceptance and cannot price the rejections that greedy asks incur. The arena, which simulates rejection, prices them: closes fall 1.6-2.0pp at 0.95 and each no-deal is a zero.
